records.rationale: Remove the full three-path out-of-band power-domain extension in 14fa69019d32. Its ACK reader is solely the companion genpd_finish_suspend/resume power-off exception (13d0c0647b78), already omitted; the generated SDK configuration does not enable PM_GENERIC_DOMAINS, whose drivers/Makefile gate excludes that subsystem. It uses ACPI/virtio PM instead. Pinned local mainline positively shows setters in TI OMAP and i.MX USB controllers with separate always-on wake logic; no such topology is added for this target. Keep exact native device_prepare and generic power-domain code, avoiding unsupported power-off semantics. Searches not finding an SDK setter are corroboration, not the sole omission rationale. records.rationale: Both paths fully reviewed: keep the opaque SRCU token, three BPF kfuncs, SYSCALL-only registration and init call as configured generic Android BPF introspection. SDK BPF_SYSCALL/BTF are enabled, but no definite SDK program consumer was established. Local verifier review shows KF_ACQUIRE/RELEASE tracking, type/offset checks and reference-leak rejection; sleepable syscall programs are required. The get_head void pointer becomes a scalar, so it grants an address rather than verifier-authorized direct memory access. It does not require a lock token: callers must acquire SRCU for meaningful traversal, and verifier pairing alone does not prove traversal lifetime. Kernel probe reads remain nofault, with existing CAP_PERFMON/token and security_locked_down checks; program load requires CAP_BPF/token. Exposing the list address and adding privileged traversal are acknowledged surface increases. No verifier relaxation or LTS lifetime fix is removed; no running BPF verification performed.

security: The ACK prerequisite-locking and data-relocation revert sequence removes a pre-v6.18 native locking fix. Restore exact locked device-name recording while retaining the Android reporting interface. Post-v6.18 stable textual scans do not cover such older fixes and are not semantic proof. Generic wait hooks and exports preserve native control flow but execute/enable trusted module code. BPF kfuncs introduce a privileged address/traversal surface, preserve existing verifier/ref and helper checks, and do not make a coherent statistics snapshot or enforce that get_head is called with SRCU held. Physical always-on-domain support is omitted together with its excluded genpd consumer; native PM safety decisions remain.
